embedded_ui.policy: Reuse all official release static assets, deterministic gzip and builtinassets; no frontend source changes.

dependency_update.policy: go get exact version; retain upstream graph and Go checksum database; emit final go.mod, go.sum and complete module graph into image provenance.

build_date_policy: Fixed to upstream release publication time, not wall clock; BuildUser identifies derivative.
verification: Recipe prepared from official source and checksum inputs; CI must build, scan both executables, verify embedded native UI and run fresh install/config reload/TSDB acceptance.
